notes: Requesty router prices as printed in its 2026-10-05 benchmark post: sference/clef $0.24/M input (output free, 64K), cloudflare/clef $0.24/M (output free, 64K), perplexity/pplx-decider-v1-27b $0.04/M (output free, 262K; conflicts with Perplexity direct $0.02). Requesty-billed cost on its gateway benchmark: Clef $0.131 and Perplexity decider $0.023 per 1,000 items (an item is one request answering 1-5 questions): see the Requesty performance doc. Jev price on Requesty (typesafe/jev-latest): NOT published in the pages read (missing; no row). Cache fields: cache_read_per_m and cache_write_per_m are null with cache_rates_status "not_published": the vendor documents no caching discount or surcharge, so no cache rate is recorded (none is inferred from the input price).

sference/clef.notes: Router listing "sference/clef | decision, 27B | $0.24 / M | free | 64K"; sference caps a request at 16 questions.

cloudflare/clef.notes: Router listing "cloudflare/clef | decision, 27B | $0.24 / M | free | 64K"; Cloudflare caps a request at 64 questions; Requesty's Cloudflare account hit its daily Workers AI quota mid-run.

perplexity/pplx-decider-v1-27b.notes: Router listing "$0.04 / M | free | 262K"; 2x the Perplexity direct price.
